globalAttributes.name: space
globalAttributes.description: Sizing & spacing: padding, margin, gap, width, height. Space-separated tokens, e.g. space="p:big m-t:small g:medium". Prefix any token with a breakpoint (mob, tab, lap, desk, print, tw-sm, tw-md, tw-lg, tw-xl, tw-2xl) and/or state (hover, focus, focus-visible, focus-within, active, checked, disabled, expanded, selected, required, optional, valid, invalid, placeholder), e.g. tab:hover:g-x:big. Theme scales are sampled in this completion list; every scale key is valid.

globalAttributes.name: visual
globalAttributes.description: Colors & appearance: background, text, borders, shadows, typography, effects. Space-separated tokens, e.g. visual="bg:primary text:white rounded:big hover:bg:blue-500". Prefix any token with a breakpoint (mob, tab, lap, desk, print, tw-sm, tw-md, tw-lg, tw-xl, tw-2xl) and/or state (hover, focus, focus-visible, focus-within, active, checked, disabled, expanded, selected, required, optional, valid, invalid, placeholder), e.g. tab:hover:align:baseline. Theme scales are sampled in this completion list; every scale key is valid.
